notes.title: It's a Demo-nstration!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44771874/13ce37da2a9665ae92775a6b84b078f5ea7ba41c.png[/img]
The demo for Tyrannical Chickens is now available! This is my first post about the game, but it won't be my last. Now that I've actually got something up I suddenly have the urge to talk all about it, who'd have thought...

Play it on Steam here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2427220/Tyrannical_Chickens/

The game is a shooter that takes a lot of influence from zombie games - the original Black Ops Zombies in particular.  It was originally going to be called Nazi Chickens, but it's hard enough as it is to get your game seen by people, let alone when 50% of its name is going to be picked up and dumped by any and every social media filter.

You run around killing hordes of chickens with silly guns and melee weapons. You can also upgrade every gun into a more powerful version - again, a throwback to the COD zombies games. 

At the moment there are ten guns in total, with plans to add a lot more in the final game. If there was a unique selling point to the game, its the weapons. I've tried to make them as fun and weird as possible. You've got a gun that swears when it shoots, another who's bullets bounce, and a ray gun (yes, you get it, I've played call of duty) - but this one shoots stingrays as bullets. 

The map is a static map, with lots of tight corridors and obstacles. I want to add and improve the decorations in the game, but for the most part, the map is going to stay as it is (famous last words, I'm sure...).

Things that aren't in the game yet, but will be, include:
[list]
[*] Bosses
[*] Power ups
[*] More guns
[/list]

Finally, if you want to sign up to my email newsletter, you can do it here:

https://mailchi.mp/859e0e2c7acc/tyrannical-chickens

It's just this, but in email format. Fun.
